title: Raw proper compact-support compositor and forget-supports comparison
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, p:W→X and f:X→S proper maps, and E an object of D(W_et,A). For the canonical composite p;f, the inverse of the specified compact-support composition isomorphism followed by the canonical proper comparison for p;f equals the ordinary composition path obtained by first comparing p, then comparing f, and finally applying the ordinary direct-image compositor.

source.place: First supported coordinate extraction before a trace; compactification compositor calculation after canonicalizing the composite

proof.text: Expand the chosen compact-support compositor through the compactification of f and the compatible compactification of p;f. Replace the comparison with the chosen compactification by the proved refinement forget-supports identity.

Move the forget-supports map through the open-extension, proper direct-image, and open/proper exchange factors using naturality, the composite counit formula, and the proved compactification base-change forget-supports equation. Cancel inverse compactification comparisons and use associativity of ordinary direct-image composition to obtain the displayed ordinary compositor.

proof_origin.why: The original target is reduced by first proving the equality-congruence expansion and isolating the canonical-composite compactification calculation.
